annotations.title: Next-year statutory limits from legal formulas

description: Statutory values for the next year computed by finwire.pl from the formulas in Polish law on the latest GUS and NBP data, before the official act (finwire_next_year_limits): pension indexation and minimum pension, minimum wage and hourly rate (statutory minimum rise), projected average wage, IKE and IKZE limits, the 30x ZUS cap, ZUS contribution bases, flat-rate tax and small CIT taxpayer limits. Each item: value, 80% interval, stage (projekcja = estimate, projekt, obwieszczenie = announced, obowiazuje = in force), calculation and backtest accuracy. Present estimates as estimates; for values in force this year use get_legal_limits.

key.description: One item key, e.g. pension_indexation, min_wage, ike, ikze, pension_base_cap_30x, zus_full_base, ryczalt_limit. Default all.
